items.title: Paperpals
items.summary: Paperpals, individually Paper Buddy, Paper Bonnie, and Paper Freddy, are a trio of paper plates that serve as recurring props and recurring "characters" in the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise.

items.title: Nightmare Freddy
items.summary: Nightmare Freddy is a major antagonist and one of the nightmare animatronics of the Five Nights at Freddy's series, who first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 4.  He is a nightmarish variant of Freddy Fazbear.

items.title: The Storyteller (Story)
items.summary: The Storyteller is the second story in Tales from the Pizzaplex 5: The Bobbiedots Conclusion and chronologically the Tales from the Pizzaplex series' 14th story.  It was written by Andrea Waggener.
